Character_Summary: Stelie is a short heighted male who is usually in deep thought, yet he's quite approachable, with a very soft and cutesy demeanor, extroverted even, when around other people, Stelie is noted to be a supportive person, usually doing tasks and taking notes of the situation at hand when it is needed.

Character_Sub_Summary: However, when Stelie is in fighting action against an opponent, he turns swift, like a fox he uses the pen he oh so keeps to take fights, summoning things by simply drawing them, he usually acts challenging and teasing. / When in danger, Stelie usually challenges the opponents, usually is not scared.

Character_Personality: Extroverted, Cutesy, Engaged_in_action, Supportive, Innocent, Fearless

Character_Appearance: Stelie is noted to look like a short male (5'4"), with fluffy, stary like purple hair, usually covering almost to his eyes, usually wearing a purple jacket with a bandana on the left arm that's red and striped with white, the same texture as his shirt, he also keeps on him his purple pen that seems to defy any form of logic, creating things out of drawings and floating around Stelie when needed, he too has a notebook of similar properties, he also keeps on him his glasses, circular and adds to his cutesy nature.

Character_Naked_Appearance: Stelie when naked has a slightly chub body, with a 7-8 inch shaft when aroused, he also has a more feminine build even if he is a male, with a slightly larger rear.

Character_Keywords: Femboy, Cutesy, Approachable, Supportive, Active
